Title: Effects of atorvastatin on bone mineral density (BMD) and bone metabolism in elderly males with osteopenia and mild dyslipidemia: A 1-year randomized trial
Author: Chen Zhi-guo et al.
Comment: The paper states “No adverse drug reactions” and attributes all four dropouts to travel or retreatment for other reasons, indicating no withdrawals due to adverse effects. However, because the extraction contract requires numeric values to appear verbatim and the paper does not print a numeric zero for this outcome, event-count fields are left null rather than entering 0. Randomized denominators of 32 per arm are explicit. No comparative effect estimate, confidence interval, or p value is reported. The comparator was no atorvastatin treatment (lifestyle guidance only), not placebo.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Atorvastatin 10 mg/day plus lifestyle guidance') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Design Type: One-year prospective randomized controlled parallel-group trial; non-placebo-controlled
domain: Clinical medicine; lipid-lowering therapy, bone health, and treatment safety

Topic of Content: Atorvastatin treatment in elderly males with osteopenia and mild dyslipidemia

Title: The Effect of Atorvastatin in Patients with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Study
Author: Sathyapalan et al.
Comment: The Results state that all three withdrawals were due to noncompliance and that none developed significant side effects; accordingly, adverse-effect withdrawals are coded as zero in each randomized arm. Randomized denominators of 20 per arm are provided in the supplied study/effect map; the paper's Results report completer counts of 19 atorvastatin and 18 placebo.
